contract: set_log_listener registers the emitting socket at the Logger for one level: admin only; a non-integer level or one outside LogLevel (0-6) is rejected with a WARN log and replaces nothing; a rejected call from a non-admin or unauthenticated socket replaces nothing; a second call on the same socket replaces the level; the Logger then delivers every log call as a log event {timestamp, source, message, levelName, level} on that socket only, while the event level is at least the listener level.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
force is not applicable: set_log_listener has no force or override mode.

Delivery of FATAL and NOTE events (always delivered, server/Logger.js:84-86) is not asserted: no offline-deterministic trigger exists (Logger.fatal fires only on uncaught errors and missing binaries, and Logger.note has no caller in server/).
The log message field is asserted as a non-empty string and identified by stable trigger substrings; the full log text is not pinned.
